name: Cash collected before the fest
business_meaning: The North Star: cash-type sponsorship actually received before festival start
formula: SUM(receipt.amount) where receipt.received_at < fest_start and deal.support_type = cash
time_period: season to date; cut-off = festival start
inclusion_exclusion: Excludes in-kind, signed-but-unpaid and post-fest receipts
example_calculation: NOT COMPUTABLE on the 2025 dataset: no payment, invoice or receipt table exists (audit B12)

name: Signed (confirmed) value
business_meaning: Value agreed in confirmed partnerships; a leading indicator, not cash
formula: SUM(confirmed_value_inr) of the latest version per opportunity with stage = partner_confirmed, as of D
time_period: as of a date (latest version ≤ end of day D)
inclusion_exclusion: Includes in-kind; excludes withdrawn/lost; never call it cash
sql_2025: select sum(f.confirmed_value_inr) from core.opportunity_final f join stg.opportunities o using(opportunity_id) where f.stage='partner_confirmed'

name: Signed cash-type value
business_meaning: Signed value of deals whose consideration is cash
formula: SUM(confirmed_value_inr) where support_type = cash
inclusion_exclusion: Excludes in-kind deals
sql_2025: select sum(f.confirmed_value_inr) from core.opportunity_final f join stg.opportunities o using(opportunity_id) where f.stage='partner_confirmed' and o.support_type='cash'

name: In-kind value
business_meaning: Signed value of goods or services instead of cash; never counted as cash
formula: SUM(confirmed_value_inr) where support_type = in_kind
inclusion_exclusion: Reported in its own column
sql_2025: select sum(f.confirmed_value_inr) from core.opportunity_final f join stg.opportunities o using(opportunity_id) where f.stage='partner_confirmed' and o.support_type='in_kind'

name: Cash-type share of signed value
business_meaning: Share of signed value that is cash-type
sql_2025: select round(sum(case when o.support_type='cash' then f.confirmed_value_inr end)/sum(f.confirmed_value_inr),4) from core.opportunity_final f join stg.opportunities o using(opportunity_id) where f.stage='partner_confirmed'

name: Collected ÷ signed cash
business_meaning: Whether signed value is becoming money before the fest (T−7 gate ≥ 0.85)
time_period: weekly from W4; gate at T−7
inclusion_exclusion: Cash-type deals only
example_calculation: NOT COMPUTABLE on the 2025 dataset: no payment, invoice or receipt table exists (audit B12)

name: Outstanding cash from signed sponsors
business_meaning: Signed cash-type value not yet received
formula: M-03 − M-01 (by deal: confirmed cash value − receipts)
inclusion_exclusion: Cash-type deals only; post-fest payers flagged
example_calculation: NOT COMPUTABLE on the 2025 dataset: no payment, invoice or receipt table exists (audit B12)

name: Cumulative signed value by week
business_meaning: Pacing: signed value reached by the end of each week, compared with the W4–W9 gates
formula: SUM(confirmed value of opportunities first confirmed ≤ end of week)
inclusion_exclusion: In-window channels only for the gates; pre-season premium value tracked separately (K-G-04); confirmed-then-withdrawn deals excluded at their final state
sql_2025: select sum(f.confirmed_value_inr) from core.opportunity_final f join core.opportunity_stage_reached r using(opportunity_id) where f.stage='partner_confirmed' and r.stage='partner_confirmed' and r.first_reached_at_ist < timestamp '2025-03-16'
example_calculation: Confirmed before 16 Mar 2025 (end of 15 Mar): ₹14.25L signed

name: Confirmed partnerships
business_meaning: Count of opportunities in partner_confirmed at the cut-off
formula: COUNT(opportunity) with latest stage = partner_confirmed
inclusion_exclusion: One brand can have several opportunities
sql_2025: select count(*) from core.opportunity_final where stage='partner_confirmed'

name: Qualified brands
business_meaning: Brands whose latest qualification version is qualified
formula: COUNT(brand) with latest qualification_status = qualified as of D
inclusion_exclusion: Latest version only; never sum versions
sql_2025: select count(*) from core.qualification_final where qualification_status='qualified'

name: Meeting rate
business_meaning: Share of touched brands that held a meeting
formula: brands met ÷ brands touched, per campaign or channel group
inclusion_exclusion: Attempts before festival start; brand level
sql_2025: select round(sum(brands_met)::double/sum(brands_touched),3) from eda.q4_campaign_funnel where campaign_name='Creator Network Referrals'

name: Proposal rate (brand level)
business_meaning: Share of met warm/inbound brands that received a proposal
formula: brands with a proposal ÷ brands met
numerator: qualified brands with a proposal (val.handoff_register status C)
inclusion_exclusion: Brand level (a brand with two opportunities counts once)
sql_2025: select round(count(*) filter (where h.handoff_status='C_proposal_sent')::double/(select brands_met from eda.q4_campaign_funnel where campaign_name='Creator Network Referrals'),3) from val.handoff_register h where h.qual_campaign='Creator Network Referrals'

name: Win rate per proposal
business_meaning: Share of proposals that became confirmed partnerships
formula: won opportunities ÷ opportunities that reached proposal_sent
inclusion_exclusion: Opportunity level; withdrawn after confirmation counts as not won
sql_2025: select round(sum(won)::double/sum(proposals),3) from eda.q4_campaign_funnel where channel_group='cold'

name: Brand win rate
business_meaning: Share of touched brands that became partners
formula: won brands ÷ brands touched (first-touch attribution unless stated)
inclusion_exclusion: State the attribution rule
sql_2025: select round(wins::double/denom_units,3) from eda.q3_attribution where rule like 'B:%' and channel_group='warm'

name: Mean won deal size
business_meaning: Average confirmed value of won deals
formula: AVG(confirmed_value_inr) of partner_confirmed opportunities
inclusion_exclusion: Signed value; includes in-kind unless filtered
sql_2025: select round(avg(f.confirmed_value_inr),0) from core.opportunity_final f join stg.opportunities o using(opportunity_id) where f.stage='partner_confirmed'

name: Median won deal size
business_meaning: Median confirmed value of won deals
formula: MEDIAN(confirmed_value_inr)
inclusion_exclusion: As M-15
sql_2025: select median(f.confirmed_value_inr) from core.opportunity_final f join stg.opportunities o using(opportunity_id) where f.stage='partner_confirmed'

name: Handoff leak rate
business_meaning: Share of qualified warm/inbound brands that never got an opportunity
formula: qualified brands with no opportunity ÷ qualified brands
inclusion_exclusion: Warm + inbound unless stated (cold: 6 of 24)
sql_2025: select round(count(*) filter (where handoff_status='A_no_opportunity')::double/count(*),3) from val.handoff_register where channel_group<>'cold'

name: Deal record within 5 days
business_meaning: Share of qualified leads with an opportunity created within 5 days of first qualification
formula: qualified leads with days_qual_to_opp ≤ 5 ÷ qualified leads
time_period: weekly cohort of newly qualified leads
inclusion_exclusion: Warm + inbound (+ VC/creator leads in live use)
sql_2025: select round(count(*) filter (where days_qual_to_opp <= 5)::double/count(*),3) from val.handoff_register where channel_group<>'cold'

name: Qualified → proposal within 10 days
business_meaning: Share of qualified leads with a proposal sent within 10 days (SLA gate: keep ≥ 80%, escalate < 63%)
formula: qualified leads with days_qual_to_proposal ≤ 10 ÷ qualified leads
inclusion_exclusion: As M-18
sql_2025: select round(count(*) filter (where days_qual_to_proposal <= 10)::double/count(*),3) from val.handoff_register where channel_group<>'cold'

name: Days from creation to confirmation
business_meaning: Sales-cycle length for won deals
formula: AVG(confirmed_at − created_at) in days
inclusion_exclusion: Won deals only
sql_2025: select round(avg(date_diff('day', o.created_at_ist, r.first_reached_at_ist)),1) from stg.opportunities o join core.opportunity_stage_reached r using(opportunity_id) join core.opportunity_final f using(opportunity_id) where r.stage='partner_confirmed' and f.stage='partner_confirmed'

name: Open pipeline value
business_meaning: Proposed value of opportunities still open (not a forecast)
formula: SUM(proposed_value_inr) of latest versions with stage_class = open
inclusion_exclusion: Face value; in 2025 all open value is cold (0 of 21 cold proposals won)
sql_2025: select sum(proposed_value_inr) from core.opportunity_final where stage_class='open'

name: Cold share of outreach attempts
business_meaning: Share of attempts spent on cold-only campaigns (expected 0 after W1 day 1)
formula: cold attempts ÷ all attempts
inclusion_exclusion: All attempts incl. post-fest
sql_2025: select round(count(*) filter (where g.channel_group='cold')::double/count(*),3) from core.attempts a join eda.campaign_group g using(campaign_id)

name: Response rate (brand level)
business_meaning: Share of touched brands that replied, were introduced or submitted
formula: brands responded ÷ brands touched
inclusion_exclusion: Introductions and form submissions count as responses (no delivery step)
sql_2025: select round(brands_responded::double/brands_touched,3) from eda.q4_campaign_funnel where campaign_name='Brand Leader LinkedIn'

name: Confirmed vs target
business_meaning: Progress against the dated target in force
formula: confirmed partnerships as of D ÷ confirmed_partnerships_goal in force at D
inclusion_exclusion: Uses the latest target version effective on or before D
sql_2025: select round((select count(*) from core.opportunity_stage_reached where stage='partner_confirmed' and first_reached_at_ist < timestamp '2025-03-16')::double/(select confirmed_partnerships_goal from stg.targets where effective_at_ist < timestamp '2025-03-16' order by effective_at_ist desc limit 1),3)

name: Advance paid within 7 days
business_meaning: Share of signed cash deals whose advance arrived within 7 days (keep ≥ 85%, escalate < 74%)
formula: deals with advance receipt ≤ signing + 7 days ÷ signed cash deals
inclusion_exclusion: Cash-type deals
example_calculation: NOT COMPUTABLE on the 2025 dataset: no payment, invoice or receipt table exists (audit B12)

name: Premium value signed pre-season
business_meaning: Signed premium-inventory value before W1, tracked apart from pacing gates
formula: SUM(confirmed value) of premium-asset deals signed before W1
inclusion_exclusion: Premium assets only
example_calculation: NOT COMPUTABLE on the 2025 dataset: no inventory or asset sales exist

name: Hours vs model rates
business_meaning: Logged hours per task ÷ the model's hours per task (trigger > 1.3 at W2)
formula: SUM(logged hours by task type) ÷ SUM(model hours for the same tasks)
inclusion_exclusion: By task type and bet
example_calculation: NOT COMPUTABLE on the 2025 dataset: no hours or staffing data

name: Interested past sponsors
business_meaning: Past sponsors interested after the screening call
formula: COUNT(renewal screening = interested)
inclusion_exclusion: The 24 sponsors of 2025
example_calculation: NOT COMPUTABLE on the 2025 dataset: renewals are a 2026 activity

name: Committed introductions
business_meaning: Introductions with a named decision-maker who agreed to meet
formula: COUNT(introduction where committed = true)
inclusion_exclusion: Speculative introductions excluded
example_calculation: NOT COMPUTABLE on the 2025 dataset: 0 committed today (D-010)

name: Scenario expected cash (approved)
business_meaning: The approved forecast for a scenario; read, never recomputed
formula: scenario_catalogue.expected_cash where scenario_id = SC-01/SC-02/SC-03
inclusion_exclusion: Only rows with status APPROVED are targets
